scope: Current rendered StudioReferenceLayout navigation and workspace screens

navigation: Top tabs now switch between projects, processing, recognition, drawings, BIM and reports.
Sidebar buttons now switch between project data, processing, recognition results, drawings, BIM, reports and project information.
Sidebar navigation uses native buttons for keyboard and accessibility semantics.
Project/cloud page uses existing project, cloud selection, import and project creation handlers.
Header search lists project, cloud and candidate matches; selecting a match opens its project/cloud or selects the candidate in the 3D processing view.
Sidebar source rows open the corresponding page and filter current project clouds to all, ready, or FARO/RCS sources.
The 360 toolbar and data source now open the existing station panorama viewer for the selected cloud.
3D toolbar toggles point-cloud visibility, structural candidate geometry and point-pick mode; the picked point is reported in metres.
Drawing screen connects DXF, PDF and SPDS album download controls to existing API functions.
BIM screen connects IFC, JSON and DXF download controls to existing API functions.
Reports and project information are populated from loaded application state.

not_performed: No point-pick coordinate was accepted by a user click; only the mode toggle was checked.
No export button was clicked, so no drawing/model files were generated during browser smoke.
This verifies the UI, panorama image delivery, and control wiring, not the AutoCAD/Revit host acceptance criteria.
